note: Bembo to Querini: having used spectacles all this time, as you know, I now read my office and every letter without them; sight recovered. ONSET living pin 1545.
source: Scotto 1552 vol.2 lib.XI n.256; Travi 2477; IA ita-bnc-ald-00000347-001
